parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline the role of DNA polymerase in the replication of DNA.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: Floxuridine is a drug used to treat cancer.
parts.text:
Floxuridine inhibits DNA replication.

Suggest why the inhibition of DNA replication is an effective treatment for cancer.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
Floxuridine prevents thymine nucleotides being produced.

Explain why floxuridine does **not** affect transcription.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Name the stage of the cell cycle occurring in Fig. 6.1.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why smoking tobacco increases the risk of developing lung cancer.
